sections.summary: Xavier Huillard is Chairman of VINCI's Board of Directors. As of May 2024, Xavier Huillard is Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of VINCI; his term as CEO ends in 2025 at the General Meeting approving the 2024 financial statements, and his terms as Director and Chairman of the Board remain in force until the 2026 Annual General Meeting. The appointment of Pierre Anjolras as Chief Operating Officer is the first step in the implementation of Xavier Huillard's succession plan. On 3 May 2024, Xavier Huillard appointed Pierre Anjolras as Chief Operating Officer of VINCI, and the Board of Directors he chairs unanimously approved the appointment. As PDG of Vinci, Xavier Huillard publicly criticized the report remitted to the government concerning the abandonment of the Notre-Dame-des-Landes airport project (per Public Sénat coverage).
